File No. __________
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 1, Special Branch [手写: D. 8629]
REPORT
Date July 28, 1938.
Subject Aron Haikin, communications dated 20.7.38 from H.B.M. Consulate-
General.
Made by D.P.S. Pavloff Forwarded by [签名]

ARON HAIKIN, Russian Jew, was born in 1902. Prior to
his arrival in Shanghai it is reported that he together with
his brother N. Haikin were operating several brothels in
Harbin. He arrived in Shanghai in 1929 and first came to
the notice of the Police in 1932 when on April 13, 1932 he
was charged with gambling and sentenced to $500 fine by the
2nd Special District Court and again on November 4, 1933
he appeared in the same court on a charge of Heroin Smoking
but was acquitted of that charge. At present he and his
brother operate a so-called Employment Agency at 697/13,
Avenue Joffre, the main object of which, it is believed, is
to supply Russian dancing girls and prostitutes to Japanese
bars in Hongkew and Yangtsepoo districts. It is also
reported that he is dealing in Heroin, supplying it to Russian
dancing girls and prostitutes.

Aron Haikin is a professional card-sharper and habitual
drug-addict and is known for his association with criminals.
Although he was not involved in any case of forging passports,
he would not be adverse to obtain [插入: any] one for any person.

[签名]
D. D. S.

[左侧边缘手写批注]:
D.C.
28/7.
P. A. to D C (Sp. Br.)

D.C. (Special Branch)

档案号 ___
上海公共租界工部局警务处。
特务科 [手写: D. 8629]
报告
日期：1938年7月28日。
事由：阿龙·海金（Aron Haikin），英国驻沪总领事馆1938年7月20日来函。
呈报人：副警务总监 帕夫洛夫（Pavloff） 转呈 [签名]

阿龙·海金，俄籍犹太人，生于1902年。据报，在抵达上海之前，他与其兄弟N. 海金曾在哈尔滨经营多家妓院。他于1929年抵达上海，并于1932年首次引起警方注意；当时他在1932年4月13日因赌博罪被第二特区法院判处500美元罚款；随后又于1933年11月4日在同一法院受审，被控吸食海洛因，但该指控不成立，获判无罪。目前，他与兄弟在霞飞路697/13号经营一家所谓的“职业介绍所”，据悉其主要目的是向虹口和杨树浦地区的日本酒吧提供俄国舞女和妓女。另有报告称，他从事海洛因交易，向俄国舞女和妓女供应毒品。

阿龙·海金是一名职业赌棍和 habitual drug-addict（习惯性吸毒者），并以与罪犯交往而闻名。虽然他未卷入任何伪造护照案件，但他并不反对为任何人获取[插入: 任何]此类证件。

[签名]
D. D. S.

[左侧边缘手写批注]:
D.C.
7月28日。
P. A. 致 D C（特务科）

D.C.（特务科）

pages.en:
No. 56
His Excellency the Governor, Hong Kong, to
His Majesty's Consul-General, Shanghai.
_______
11th July 1938.

Sir,

1. I have the honour to inform you that a former
Russian subject named Boris Vladimirovich Daniloff
arrived in Hong Kong from Shanghai on the 9th of
June, 1938, by the s.s. "King Yang" holding a forged
Lithuanian certificate of identity purporting to
have been issued at the Lithuanian Consulate at
Harbin on the 21st of April, 1938.

2. Daniloff admitted that the document was
forged and stated that he wished to travel to
Siam but being unable to obtain a Chinese passport,
was approached through a third person by a Russian
Jew named Aaron Haikin who obtained the forged
document and handed it to Daniloff on receiving the
sum of $300.00.

3. Daniloff has been sentenced to imprisonment
for 2 months and an expulsion order made against
him. He has ample means to pay for his return to
Shanghai. There are no police records in Hong Kong
regarding Aaron Haikin.
-------
3. I enclose the forged document and would
suggest that the matter might be brought to the
notice of your Lithuanian colleague and the Shanghai
Municipal Police.

I have the honour to be,

Sir,

Your most obedient servant,

(Sd) G. A. S. Northcote

Governor.
pages.zh:
第56号
香港总督阁下致
英国驻沪总领事。
_______
1938年7月11日。

先生：

1. 本人荣幸地通知您，一名名为鲍里斯·弗拉基米罗维奇·达尼洛夫（Boris Vladimirovich Daniloff）的前俄国臣民，于1938年6月9日乘坐“King Yang”号轮船从上海抵达香港，持有一份伪造的立陶宛身份证，该证件声称于1938年4月21日由立陶宛驻哈尔滨领事馆签发。

2. 达尼洛夫承认该文件系伪造，并陈述他希望前往暹罗，但因无法获得中国护照，便通过第三人联系了一名名为亚伦·海金（Aaron Haikin）的俄籍犹太人，后者取得了该伪造文件，并在收取300.00美元后将其交给达尼洛夫。

3. 达尼洛夫已被判处监禁两个月，并被下达驱逐令。他有足够的财力支付返回上海的费用。香港方面没有关于亚伦·海金的警方记录。
-------
3. 现随函附上该伪造文件，并建议将此事项提请贵方立陶宛同僚及上海公共租界工部局警务处注意。

本人荣幸地成为，

先生，

您最顺从的仆人，

(签署) G. A. S. 诺思科特

总督。

pages.en:
His Majesty's Consul-General, Shanghai, to
His Excellency the Governor, Hongkong.

July 20th 1938.

Sir,

I have the honour to acknowledge the
receipt of Your Excellency's despatch No.58
dated July 9th, and to inform you that in
the absence of a Li huanian colleague in
Shanghai the forged document forwarded in
your despatch has been sent to the Commissioner
of the Shanghai Municipal Police with a request
for a report regarding Aaron Haikin.

2. A copy of the Police report will be
forwarded to Your Excellency in due course.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your Excellency's most
obedient servant,

(Sd) Herbert Phillips

Consul-General.
pages.zh:
英国驻沪总领事致
香港总督阁下。

1938年7月20日。

先生：

本人荣幸地确认收到阁下1938年7月9日发出的第58号公函，并告知您，由于上海没有立陶宛同僚，贵方公函中附送的伪造文件已转送上海公共租界工部局警务总监，并要求其就亚伦·海金一事提交报告。

2. 警方报告的副本将在适当时候呈送阁下。

本人荣幸地成为，
先生，
阁下最顺从的仆人，

(签署) 赫伯特·菲利普斯

总领事。
